canonical_integrity_fingerprint_policy.authority_boundary: INTEGRITY_ONLY; NEVER_CREATES_ACCEPTED_MEMBERSHIP, CURRENT_AUTHORITY, LIVE_READINESS, OR SELF_ENROLLMENT

scope_hierarchy.composition: PRODUCT_SYSTEM is the root policy scope. WORKSPACE is its child. PORTFOLIO is a WORKSPACE child and EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT its child. STRATEGY_INSTANCE, INSTRUMENT and EXECUTION_ROUTE are WORKSPACE-owned intersecting qualifiers, applicable only when their exact IDs occur in the evaluated command; they are incomparable peers, not invented parents. Exact ancestry and qualifiers come from accepted upstream projections.
scope_hierarchy.applicability: same concrete environment and exact ancestor/qualifier identity only
scope_hierarchy.ordering: fixed applicable_order then scope_id then policy revision; never container iteration
scope_hierarchy.incomparable_conflict: two applicable policies at the same exact scope identity and revision with unequal semantic fingerprints => POLICY_CONFLICT

risk_policy_contract.immutability: identity, revision, limits and fingerprints fixed for one evaluation
risk_policy_contract.upstream_identity: M0.2 RiskPolicy: risk_policy_id, prefix rpol, UUIDv7
risk_policy_contract.coverage: at least one applicable current accepted policy with explicit ALLOW or DENY is required; zero applicable policies is RISK_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE
risk_policy_contract.enabled_limit_validation: before composition: canonical rpol UUIDv7, positive non-bool revision, closed environment/scope/action, exact scope ID prefix, supported limit name, Fraction-only threshold and exact AssetReference unit; known unsupported or unknown names return UNSUPPORTED_RISK_SEMANTICS

risk_policy_authority_boundary.required: a validated PrevalidatedRiskPolicyContext whose complete record/history content, semantic fingerprints, current designations, context fingerprint and CoreAcceptedContentBinding independently validate; a nominal class name alone is not authority
risk_policy_authority_boundary.nominal_membership: pre-existing Core membership identifier is an independent reference-model input; hashes prove integrity and cannot self-enroll

steps: validate every accepted context and concrete environment
select exact ancestors and exact command qualifiers
reject duplicate exact scope/revision with different semantics
for each required supported limit take minimum threshold for maximum limits and maximum threshold for minimum limits
sort results by closed limit registry order and supplying scope order
effective_policy_resolution.current_revision: exactly one designated current revision per (risk_policy_id, environment, scope_type, scope_id); two designations conflict; accepted newer history makes designation of an older revision a rollback conflict; missing, duplicate or semantically conflicting designated record fails POLICY_CONFLICT
effective_policy_resolution.deny: any applicable current DENY produces RISK_DENIED before numeric composition
effective_policy_resolution.coverage: zero applicable current accepted policies is RISK_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE; optional absence of a limit is authorized only by explicit ALLOW policy semantics
effective_policy_resolution.effective_set_fence: SHA-256 over closed-scope-ordered immutable bindings of every effective policy ID, current revision, action and recomputed semantic fingerprint
effective_policy_resolution.ordering: current applicable policies are ordered only by scope_hierarchy.applicable_order, then scope_id, then revision; input record/current container order is irrelevant

kill_switch_contract.generation_validation: generation is positive and strictly increases per exact scope/environment history; duplicate/reuse/rollback or unknown state fails TRUSTED_CONTEXT_FAILURE

kill_switch_hierarchy.applicability: same hierarchy/qualifiers and exact environment as policy

Dispatch retrieves the exact accepted historical RiskDecision, recomputes all its semantic fields/fingerprint, requires ALLOW and matching lease binding, then revalidates current execution authority, policy/switch fences, POST accounting, reservation and lifetime; it does not reinterpret the historical PRE decision.
